svg.title: Sonder system architecture, Iteration 1 (view A)
svg.text: Adaptive misconception diagnosis for Maths · deterministic engine, teacher-reviewed results · status as of 12 October 2026
NEXT.JS DEPLOYMENT · ONE PROCESS · CPU APP HOST
✓ calls engine · serves static assets ○ authenticates · scopes rows
DB sessions · class and enrolment scope
deterministic · no LLM · no network · no DB
diagnostic units · engine params · response model
✓ written + tested in CI ○ on Neon

Solid boxes and arrows = required for Mid-1 (badges show what is already built). Grey dashed = later iterations. No LLM is on the diagnosis path; teachers review results before any release (Iteration 2).
Sources: docs/ENGINE_SPEC_DRAFT.md (spec v2) · docs/db/iteration1 (schema revision 3) · sonder_engine/ and sonder_api/ and .github/workflows on dev · ARCHITECTURE_PLAN.md revision 2.
